# RCSB PDB entry fixtures

Unmodified public REST API responses captured on 2 October 2026:

- [4HHB](https://data.rcsb.org/rest/v1/core/entry/4HHB): historical X-ray structure, with structure authors differing from publication authors.
- [2N5E](https://data.rcsb.org/rest/v1/core/entry/2N5E): solution NMR structure, with both a PDB DOI and a BMRB DOI in `database_2`.

These snapshots make tests reproducible without network access. JSON indentation
is the only formatting change. Archive data are available under
[CC0](https://www.rcsb.org/pages/usage-policy); integrated external annotations
remain subject to their provider's terms as described by
[RCSB policies](https://www.rcsb.org/pages/policies).
